+# Robustness of ancilla-free testers
+
+## Abstract
+
+Ancilla-free testers with a common normalization state have the robustness of their canonical POVMs.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (Quantum testers).**
+
+$$\forall (y: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (x: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (j: \operatorname{Type}), ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(y\right)], ([\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(y\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(x\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(j\right)], (\forall (t: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.IsTester}\left(t\right)) \Leftrightarrow ((\forall (a: j), (\operatorname{Matrix.PosSemidef}\left(t\left(a\right)\right))) \land (\exists (\sigma: \operatorname{Matrix}\left(x, x, \mathbb{C}\right)), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.Information.SLDSpectralEnergy.IsDensity}\left(\sigma\right)) \land (\sum_{a: j} (t\left(a\right)) = \operatorname{Matrix.kronecker}\left((1: \operatorname{Matrix}\left(y, y, \mathbb{C}\right)), \sigma\right)))))))))))))$$
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.IsTester` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Citation.* Michal Sedlák; Daniel Reitzner; Giulio Chiribella; Mário Ziman (2016). *Incompatible measurements on quantum causal networks*. DOI: [10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.00976v2>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+A tester is a finite family t of positive semidefinite effects on the output-input tensor product. Its sum is the output identity tensored with a density matrix σ on the input. Here IsDensity means positive semidefinite with complex trace equal to one. This is the tester definition in ti_pra_07.tex, lines 247–259.
+
+**Definition 1.2 (Compatibility after adding tester noise).**
+
+$$\forall (y: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (x: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (j: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (k: \operatorname{Type}), ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(y\right)], ([\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(y\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(x\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(j\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(k\right)], (\forall (lam: \mathbb{R}), (\forall (a: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), (\forall (b: (k) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.TesterCompatibleAt}\left(lam, a, b\right)) \Leftrightarrow (\exists (e: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), (\exists (f: (k) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), (\exists (c: ((j \times k)) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.IsTester}\left(e\right)) \land ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.IsTester}\left(f\right)) \land ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.IsTester}\left(c\right)) \land ((\forall (u: j), (\sum_{v: k} (c\left((u, v)\right)) = \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left((1: \mathbb{R}) - lam, a\left(u\right)\right) + \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left(lam, e\left(u\right)\right))) \land (\forall (v: k), (\sum_{u: j} (c\left((u, v)\right)) = \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left((1: \mathbb{R}) - lam, b\left(v\right)\right) + \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left(lam, f\left(v\right)\right))))))))))))))))))))))$$
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.TesterCompatibleAt` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Citation.* Michal Sedlák; Daniel Reitzner; Giulio Chiribella; Mário Ziman (2016). *Incompatible measurements on quantum causal networks*. DOI: [10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.00976v2>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The noise testers e and f have the outcome types of a and b. A joint tester c has outcomes j × k, and its marginals are the two mixtures at the same real weight lam. The three testers may have different normalization states, and the noise need not be ancilla-free. The predicate itself allows every real lam; robustness restricts lam to the unit interval. These are the marginal and noise conditions in ti_pra_07.tex, lines 451–459 and 567–570.
+
+**Definition 1.3 (Tester robustness).**
+
+$$\forall (y: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (x: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (j: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (k: \operatorname{Type}), ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(y\right)], ([\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(y\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(x\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(j\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(k\right)], (\forall (a: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), (\forall (b: (k) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left((y \times x), (y \times x), \mathbb{C}\right))), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.testerRobustness}\left(a, b\right): \mathbb{R}) = \operatorname{sInf}\left(\{(lam: \mathbb{R}) \mid ((0: \mathbb{R}) \le lam) \land ((lam \le (1: \mathbb{R})) \land (\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.TesterCompatibleAt}\left(lam, a, b\right)))\}\right))))))))))))$$
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.testerRobustness` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Citation.* Michal Sedlák; Daniel Reitzner; Giulio Chiribella; Mário Ziman (2016). *Incompatible measurements on quantum causal networks*. DOI: [10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.00976v2>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Tester robustness is the infimum of the real weights in the closed unit interval for which separate tester noises give compatible mixtures. The source uses a minimum in ti_pra_07.tex, lines 574–577; this infimum formulation makes no assertion of attainment.
+
+**Definition 1.4 (Compatibility after adding measurement noise).**
+
+$$\forall (z: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (j: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (k: \operatorname{Type}), ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(z\right)], ([\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(z\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(j\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(k\right)], (\forall (lam: \mathbb{R}), (\forall (p: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), (\forall (q: (k) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.POVMCompatibleAt}\left(lam, p, q\right)) \Leftrightarrow (\exists (u: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), (\exists (v: (k) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), (\exists (g: ((j \times k)) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), (((\forall (a: j), (\operatorname{Matrix.PosSemidef}\left(u\left(a\right)\right))) \land (\sum_{a: j} (u\left(a\right)) = (1: \operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right)))) \land (((\forall (b: k), (\operatorname{Matrix.PosSemidef}\left(v\left(b\right)\right))) \land (\sum_{b: k} (v\left(b\right)) = (1: \operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right)))) \land (((\forall (ab: (j \times k)), (\operatorname{Matrix.PosSemidef}\left(g\left(ab\right)\right))) \land (\sum_{ab: (j \times k)} (g\left(ab\right)) = (1: \operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right)))) \land ((\forall (a: j), (\sum_{b: k} (g\left((a, b)\right)) = \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left((1: \mathbb{R}) - lam, p\left(a\right)\right) + \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left(lam, u\left(a\right)\right))) \land (\forall (b: k), (\sum_{a: j} (g\left((a, b)\right)) = \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left((1: \mathbb{R}) - lam, q\left(b\right)\right) + \operatorname{HSMul.hSMul}\left(lam, v\left(b\right)\right))))))))))))))))))))$$
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.POVMCompatibleAt` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Citation.* Michal Sedlák; Daniel Reitzner; Giulio Chiribella; Mário Ziman (2016). *Incompatible measurements on quantum causal networks*. DOI: [10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.00976v2>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The families u, v and g are POVMs: every effect is positive semidefinite and each whole family sums to the identity. The two marginals of g are the mixtures of p and q with the separate noises u and v. All scalar actions in these formulas use real scalars on complex matrices. The measurement noise condition is stated in ti_pra_07.tex, lines 761–765.
+
+**Definition 1.5 (Measurement robustness).**
+
+$$\forall (z: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (j: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (k: \operatorname{Type}), ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(z\right)], ([\operatorname{DecidableEq}\left(z\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(j\right)], ([\operatorname{Fintype}\left(k\right)], (\forall (p: (j) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), (\forall (q: (k) \to (\operatorname{Matrix}\left(z, z, \mathbb{C}\right))), ((\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.povmRobustness}\left(p, q\right): \mathbb{R}) = \operatorname{sInf}\left(\{(lam: \mathbb{R}) \mid ((0: \mathbb{R}) \le lam) \land ((lam \le (1: \mathbb{R})) \land (\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.POVMCompatibleAt}\left(lam, p, q\right)))\}\right))))))))))$$
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.povmRobustness` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Citation.* Michal Sedlák; Daniel Reitzner; Giulio Chiribella; Mário Ziman (2016). *Incompatible measurements on quantum causal networks*. DOI: [10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.93.052323). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1511.00976v2>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Measurement robustness is the infimum of the weights in the closed unit interval that permit a joint POVM after adding separate noise POVMs. It expresses the robustness of ti_pra_07.tex, lines 767–770, using an infimum without asserting attainment.
+
+**Definition 1.6 (Equality for a common ancilla-free state).**
+
+$$(\operatorname{D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality.claim}) \Leftrightarrow (\forall (y: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (x: \operatorname{Type}), (\forall (j: +For a fixed lam, suppose u, v and g are noise and joint POVMs for m and n. Tensor all three families with ρ. In the reverse direction, start with arbitrary noise testers e and f and a joint tester c. Apply the partial trace over x to all three families and their marginal equations. They become POVMs, and tr ρ = 1 sends m(a) ⊗ ρ to m(a) and n(b) ⊗ ρ to n(b). +import D5.S3.Quantum.Divergence.ConditionalHockeyStickOrthogonalReduction

+/-! The common-normalization ancilla-free equality of Sedlák, Reitzner, Chiribella and
+Ziman, arXiv:1511.00976v2, Section VI.C. Partial trace and compression preserve the

+set_option autoImplicit false

+namespace D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.AncillaFreeTesterRobustnessEquality

+open scoped BigOperators ComplexOrder Kronecker
+open D5.S3.Quantum.Information.SLDSpectralEnergy (IsDensity)
+open D5.S3.Quantum.Information.PartialTraceMutualInformation
+open D5.S3.Quantum.Divergence.ConditionalHockeyStickOrthogonalReduction
+  (partialTraceRight_smul)

+/-- Positive tester effects sum to the output identity tensored with a density matrix. -/
+def IsTester {y x j : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y] [Fintype x] [Fintype j]
+    (t : j → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) : Prop :=
+  (∀ a, (t a).PosSemidef) ∧
+    ∃ σ : Matrix x x ℂ, IsDensity σ ∧ ∑ a, t a = Matrix.kronecker 1 σ
+
+/-- Separate noise testers make the two mixtures marginals of one joint tester. -/
+def TesterCompatibleAt {y x j k : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype x] [Fintype j] [Fintype k] (lam : ℝ)
+    (a : j → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) (b : k → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ (e : j → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) (f : k → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ)
+    (c : j × k → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ),
+    IsTester e ∧ IsTester f ∧ IsTester c ∧
+      (∀ u, ∑ v, c (u, v) = (1 - lam) • a u + lam • e u) ∧
+      (∀ v, ∑ u, c (u, v) = (1 - lam) • b v + lam • f v)
+
+/-- Infimum of the admissible mixing parameters in the unit interval. -/
+def testerRobustness {y x j k : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype x] [Fintype j] [Fintype k]
+    (a : j → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) (b : k → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) : ℝ :=
+  sInf {lam : ℝ | 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ TesterCompatibleAt lam a b}
+
+/-- Separate noise POVMs make the two mixtures marginals of one joint POVM. -/
+def POVMCompatibleAt {z j k : Type} [Fintype z] [DecidableEq z]
+    [Fintype j] [Fintype k] (lam : ℝ)
+    (p : j → Matrix z z ℂ) (q : k → Matrix z z ℂ) : Prop :=
+  ∃ (u : j → Matrix z z ℂ) (v : k → Matrix z z ℂ)
+    (g : j × k → Matrix z z ℂ),
+    ((∀ a, (u a).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ a, u a = 1) ∧
+    ((∀ b, (v b).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ b, v b = 1) ∧
+    ((∀ ab, (g ab).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ ab, g ab = 1) ∧
+      (∀ a, ∑ b, g (a, b) = (1 - lam) • p a + lam • u a) ∧
+      (∀ b, ∑ a, g (a, b) = (1 - lam) • q b + lam • v b)
+
+/-- Infimum of the POVM mixing parameters in the unit interval. -/
+def povmRobustness {z j k : Type} [Fintype z] [DecidableEq z]
+    [Fintype j] [Fintype k]
+    (p : j → Matrix z z ℂ) (q : k → Matrix z z ℂ) : ℝ :=
+  sInf {lam : ℝ | 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ POVMCompatibleAt lam p q}
+
+/-- The canonical POVMs act on the output and the support of the common input state. -/
+def claim : Prop :=
+  ∀ (y x j k : Type) [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y] [Fintype x] [DecidableEq x]
+    [Fintype j] [DecidableEq j] [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k]
+    (ρ : Matrix x x ℂ) (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ),
+    IsDensity ρ → ((∀ a, (m a).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ a, m a = 1) →
+    ((∀ b, (n b).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ b, n b = 1) →
+      testerRobustness (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a) ρ)
+        (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) ρ) =
+      povmRobustness (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a)
+        (1 : Matrix (Fin ρ.rank) (Fin ρ.rank) ℂ))
+        (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) (1 : Matrix (Fin ρ.rank) (Fin ρ.rank) ℂ))
+
+private theorem kronecker_sum {y x j : Type} [Fintype j]
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (ρ : Matrix x x ℂ) :
+    (∑ a, Matrix.kronecker (m a) ρ) = Matrix.kronecker (∑ a, m a) ρ := by
+  exact (map_sum ((Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := ℂ)).flip ρ) m Finset.univ).symm
+
+private theorem povm_tensor_tester {y x j : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype x] [Fintype j] (ρ : Matrix x x ℂ) (hρ : IsDensity ρ)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (hm : (∀ a, (m a).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ a, m a = 1) :
+    IsTester (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a) ρ) := by
+  refine ⟨fun a => (hm.1 a).kronecker hρ.1, ρ, hρ, ?_⟩
+  rw [kronecker_sum, hm.2]
+
+private theorem partialTraceRight_sum {y x j : Type} [Fintype x] [Fintype j]
+    (t : j → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ) :
+    partialTraceRight (∑ a, t a) = ∑ a, partialTraceRight (t a) := by
+  ext a b
+  rw [Matrix.sum_apply]
+  change (∑ c, (∑ u, t u) (a, c) (b, c)) = ∑ u, ∑ c, t u (a, c) (b, c)
+  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply]
+  exact Finset.sum_comm
+
+private theorem tester_partialTrace_povm {y x j : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype x] [Fintype j] (t : j → Matrix (y × x) (y × x) ℂ)
+    (ht : IsTester t) : (∀ a, (partialTraceRight (t a)).PosSemidef) ∧
+      ∑ a, partialTraceRight (t a) = 1 := by
+  refine ⟨fun a => partialTraceRight_posSemidef (ht.1 a), ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hs⟩ := ht.2
+  rw [← partialTraceRight_sum, hs, partialTraceRight_kronecker, hσ.2, one_smul]
+
+private theorem povm_to_tester_compatible {y x j k : Type}
+    [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y] [Fintype x] [Fintype j] [Fintype k]
+    (ρ : Matrix x x ℂ) (hρ : IsDensity ρ) (lam : ℝ)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ)
+    (h : POVMCompatibleAt lam m n) :
+    TesterCompatibleAt lam (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a) ρ)
+      (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) ρ) := by
+  obtain ⟨u, v, g, hu, hv, hg, hgm, hgn⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨fun a => Matrix.kronecker (u a) ρ,
+    fun b => Matrix.kronecker (v b) ρ,
+    fun ab => Matrix.kronecker (g ab) ρ,
+    povm_tensor_tester ρ hρ u hu, povm_tensor_tester ρ hρ v hv,
+    povm_tensor_tester ρ hρ g hg, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro a
+    rw [kronecker_sum, hgm a]
+    change ((1 - lam) • m a + lam • u a) ⊗ₖ ρ =
+      (1 - lam) • (m a ⊗ₖ ρ) + lam • (u a ⊗ₖ ρ)
+    rw [Matrix.add_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker]
+  · intro b
+    rw [kronecker_sum, hgn b]
+    change ((1 - lam) • n b + lam • v b) ⊗ₖ ρ =
+      (1 - lam) • (n b ⊗ₖ ρ) + lam • (v b ⊗ₖ ρ)
+    rw [Matrix.add_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker]
+
+private theorem tester_to_povm_compatible {y x j k : Type}
+    [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y] [Fintype x] [Fintype j] [Fintype k]
+    (ρ : Matrix x x ℂ) (hρ : IsDensity ρ) (lam : ℝ)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ)
+    (h : TesterCompatibleAt lam (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a) ρ)
+      (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) ρ)) : POVMCompatibleAt lam m n := by
+  obtain ⟨e, f, c, he, hf, hc, hcm, hcn⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨fun a => partialTraceRight (e a), fun b => partialTraceRight (f b),
+    fun ab => partialTraceRight (c ab), tester_partialTrace_povm e he,
+    tester_partialTrace_povm f hf, tester_partialTrace_povm c hc, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro a
+    rw [← partialTraceRight_sum, hcm a, partialTraceRight_add,
+      partialTraceRight_smul, partialTraceRight_smul,
+      partialTraceRight_kronecker, hρ.2, one_smul]
+  · intro b
+    rw [← partialTraceRight_sum, hcn b, partialTraceRight_add,
+      partialTraceRight_smul, partialTraceRight_smul,
+      partialTraceRight_kronecker, hρ.2, one_smul]
+
+private theorem povm_tensor_identity {y j : Type} [Finite y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype j] (r : ℕ) (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (hm : (∀ a, (m a).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ a, m a = 1) :
+    (∀ a, (Matrix.kronecker (m a) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ)).PosSemidef) ∧
+      ∑ a, Matrix.kronecker (m a) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ) = 1 := by
+  refine ⟨fun a => (hm.1 a).kronecker (Matrix.PosSemidef.one), ?_⟩
+  rw [kronecker_sum, hm.2]
+  exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
+
+private theorem povm_to_ancilla_compatible {y j k : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype j] [Fintype k] (r : ℕ) (lam : ℝ)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ)
+    (h : POVMCompatibleAt lam m n) :
+    POVMCompatibleAt lam (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a)
+      (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))
+      (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ)) := by
+  obtain ⟨u, v, g, hu, hv, hg, hgm, hgn⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨fun a => Matrix.kronecker (u a) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ),
+    fun b => Matrix.kronecker (v b) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ),
+    fun ab => Matrix.kronecker (g ab) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ),
+    povm_tensor_identity r u hu, povm_tensor_identity r v hv,
+    povm_tensor_identity r g hg, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro a
+    rw [kronecker_sum, hgm a]
+    change ((1 - lam) • m a + lam • u a) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ) =
+      (1 - lam) • (m a ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ)) +
+        lam • (u a ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))
+    rw [Matrix.add_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker]
+  · intro b
+    rw [kronecker_sum, hgn b]
+    change ((1 - lam) • n b + lam • v b) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ) =
+      (1 - lam) • (n b ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ)) +
+        lam • (v b ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))
+    rw [Matrix.add_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker, Matrix.smul_kronecker]
+
+private theorem compression_povm {y j : Type} [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype j] (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
+    (m : j → Matrix (y × Fin r) (y × Fin r) ℂ) (hm : (∀ a, (m a).PosSemidef) ∧ ∑ a, m a = 1) :
+    (∀ a, ((m a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))
+      (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))).PosSemidef) ∧
+    ∑ a, (m a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)) (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)) = 1 := by
+  refine ⟨fun a => (hm.1 a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)), ?_⟩
+  have hs := congrArg (fun z : Matrix (y × Fin r) (y × Fin r) ℂ =>
+    z.submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)) (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))) hm.2
+  have hi : Function.Injective (fun b : y => (b, (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r))) :=
+    fun _ _ h => congrArg Prod.fst h
+  rw [Matrix.submatrix_one _ hi] at hs
+  calc
+    _ = (∑ a, m a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))
+        (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)) := by
+      ext a b
+      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
+    _ = 1 := hs
+
+private theorem ancilla_to_povm_compatible {y j k : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype j] [Fintype k] (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (lam : ℝ)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ)
+    (h : POVMCompatibleAt lam (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a)
+      (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))
+      (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))) :
+    POVMCompatibleAt lam m n := by
+  have hk (t : Matrix y y ℂ) (b d : y) :
+      Matrix.kronecker t (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ)
+        (b, ⟨0, hr⟩) (d, ⟨0, hr⟩) = t b d := by
+    change t b d * (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ) ⟨0, hr⟩ ⟨0, hr⟩ = t b d
+    rw [Matrix.one_apply_eq, mul_one]
+  obtain ⟨u, v, g, hu, hv, hg, hgm, hgn⟩ := h
+  refine ⟨fun a => (u a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))
+      (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)),
+    fun a => (v a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))
+      (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)),
+    fun a => (g a).submatrix (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩))
+      (fun b => (b, ⟨0, hr⟩)),
+    compression_povm r hr u hu, compression_povm r hr v hv,
+    compression_povm r hr g hg, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro a
+    ext b d
+    have he := congrArg (fun z : Matrix (y × Fin r) (y × Fin r) ℂ =>
+      z (b, ⟨0, hr⟩) (d, ⟨0, hr⟩)) (hgm a)
+    simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
+      Matrix.smul_apply, hk] using he
+  · intro a
+    ext b d
+    have he := congrArg (fun z : Matrix (y × Fin r) (y × Fin r) ℂ =>
+      z (b, ⟨0, hr⟩) (d, ⟨0, hr⟩)) (hgn a)
+    simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
+      Matrix.smul_apply, hk] using he
+
+theorem rank_pos_of_trace_one {a : Type*} [Fintype a] [DecidableEq a]
+    {A : Matrix a a ℂ} (htr : A.trace = 1) : 0 < A.rank := by
+  by_contra hn
+  have hz : A.rank = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
+  have hrange : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin = ⊥ := by
+    exact Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp hz
+  have hlin : A.mulVecLin = 0 := LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp hrange
+  have hA : A = 0 := by
+    apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
+    simpa only [Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.mulVecLin_zero] using hlin
+  simp [hA] at htr
+
+private theorem tester_feasible_eq {y x j k : Type}
+    [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y] [Fintype x] [Fintype j] [Fintype k]
+    (ρ : Matrix x x ℂ) (hρ : IsDensity ρ)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ) :
+    {lam : ℝ | 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ TesterCompatibleAt lam
+      (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a) ρ) (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) ρ)} =
+    {lam : ℝ | 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ POVMCompatibleAt lam m n} := by
+  ext lam
+  exact and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ =>
+    ⟨tester_to_povm_compatible ρ hρ lam m n, povm_to_tester_compatible ρ hρ lam m n⟩
+
+private theorem ancilla_feasible_eq {y j k : Type} [Fintype y] [DecidableEq y]
+    [Fintype j] [Fintype k] (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
+    (m : j → Matrix y y ℂ) (n : k → Matrix y y ℂ) :
+    {lam : ℝ | 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ POVMCompatibleAt lam m n} =
+    {lam : ℝ | 0 ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ POVMCompatibleAt lam
+      (fun a => Matrix.kronecker (m a) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))
+      (fun b => Matrix.kronecker (n b) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℂ))} := by
+  ext lam
+  exact and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ =>
+    ⟨povm_to_ancilla_compatible r lam m n, ancilla_to_povm_compatible r hr lam m n⟩
+
+/-- Tester and canonical measurement robustness agree for a common ancilla-free state. -/

+  intro y x j k _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ρ m n hρ _hm _hn
+  change sInf _ = sInf _
+  exact congrArg sInf ((tester_feasible_eq ρ hρ m n).trans
+    (ancilla_feasible_eq ρ.rank (rank_pos_of_trace_one hρ.2) m n))
+

+$w(\{u,x_i\})=a_i$、$w(\{v,x_i\})=b_i$ 进入 $L$ 和 $R$；

+$R(a,b)=R(K_{2,m};1)$。这里还允许任意给定的 $R_0>0$。

+## 2. 无对称假设的尖锐乘积界
+
+**定理 2.1（全部正电导上的乘积界与等号分类）。** 对定义 1.1 中每个
+$m\ge3$ 和每组独立正电导，有
+
+$$
+\lambda_2(L(a,b))R(a,b)\le C_m,
+\qquad C_m=(m+2)\left(m+\frac1m\right).
+$$
+
+等号成立当且仅当存在 $t>0$ 和一个共同的
+$\varepsilon\in\{+1,-1\}$，使对每个 $1\le i\le m$ 均有
+
+$$
+a_i=\frac t2\left(1+\varepsilon\sqrt{\frac{m-2}{m+2}}\right),\qquad
+b_i=\frac t2\left(1-\varepsilon\sqrt{\frac{m-2}{m+2}}\right).
+$$
+
+在任一等号情形，$\lambda_2=t$，完整谱为
+$0$ 一次、$t$ 共 $m$ 次、$mt$ 一次，且 $R=C_m/t$。
+因此乘积等号集恰为标号边电导空间中的这两条正射线。
+
+**证明。** 先把调和定义与谱公式接合。对任意实向量 $z$，
+
+$$
+z^{\mathsf T}Lz=\sum_{i=1}^m
+\left[a_i(z_u-z_{x_i})^2+b_i(z_v-z_{x_i})^2\right].
+$$
+
+所有电导严格为正，图连通，故 $\ker L=\mathbb R\mathbf1$，
+且 $L$ 在 $\mathbf1^\perp$ 上正定。固定两个不同边界点后，
+在其余坐标上的 Dirichlet 二次型正定：其零向量延拓为边界零值后，
+若能量为零，就必须在整个连通图上恒为零。因此线性调和方程有唯一解。
+对其解 $h$，由 $\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}Lh=0$ 得到
+
+$$
+Lh=I_{pq}(e_p-e_q),\qquad
+I_{pq}=(Lh)_p=h^{\mathsf T}Lh>0.
+$$
+
+令 $L^+$ 为在 $\mathbf1^\perp$ 上等于 $L^{-1}$、在常数空间上为零的
+Moore–Penrose 逆。作用 $L^+$ 后，取 $p,q$ 两坐标之差，得到
+
+$$
+1=I_{pq}(e_p-e_q)^{\mathsf T}L^+(e_p-e_q),\qquad
+r(p,q)=(e_p-e_q)^{\mathsf T}L^+(e_p-e_q).
+$$
+
+这是经典有效电阻恒等式，见 Ghosh–Boyd–Saberi，
+[*Minimizing Effective Resistance of a Graph*, SIAM Review 50(1), 37–66](https://web.stanford.edu/~boyd/papers/pdf/eff_res.pdf)，
+[DOI:10.1137/050645452](https://doi.org/10.1137/050645452)，§2.4，式 (8)。
+在此采用该文的电导矩阵 $G=L$、边电导 $g_{\{u,x_i\}}=a_i$、
+$g_{\{v,x_i\}}=b_i$；该文的固定总电导最小化问题不作为这里的优化结论。
+
+全点对求和使用经典的矩阵恒等式
+
+$$
+\sum_{\{p,q\}\subseteq V,\ p\ne q}
+(e_p-e_q)(e_p-e_q)^{\mathsf T}
+=nI-\mathbf1\mathbf1^{\mathsf T}.
+$$
+
+于是，由 $L^+\mathbf1=0$ 以及实对称矩阵的谱分解，
+
+$$
+R=n\operatorname{tr}(L^+)=n\sum_{j=2}^{n}\frac1{\lambda_j}.
+\tag{2.1}
+$$
+
+这正是上述文献 §2.5 式 (13)–(15) 及 Cruz Ortega–Menéndez-Conde §4
+全点对谱公式的系数；后者谱公式之后的文字将其称为迹时漏写了因子 $n$。
+这里始终使用式 (2.1) 的全点对总和。
+
+现在令 $t=\lambda_2(L)>0$，并考察叶差空间
+
+$$
+U=\left\{z\in\mathbb R^n:
+ z_u=z_v=0,\ \sum_{i=1}^m z_{x_i}=0\right\}
+ \subseteq\mathbf1^\perp.
+$$
+
+它的维数为 $m-1$。取任意正交标准基 $f_1,\ldots,f_{m-1}$。
+在叶坐标上，$U$ 的正交投影为
+$P_U=I_m-\mathbf1_m\mathbf1_m^{\mathsf T}/m$，所以
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+(m-1)t
+&\le\sum_{k=1}^{m-1}f_k^{\mathsf T}Lf_k\\
+&=\operatorname{tr}\!\left(
+\operatorname{diag}(s_1,\ldots,s_m)P_U\right)
+=\frac{m-1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^m s_i.
+\end{aligned}
+\tag{2.2}
+$$
+
+这里第一步逐项使用 $\mathbf1^\perp$ 上的 Rayleigh 下界，没有假定
+$U$ 是 $L$ 的不变子空间。由于 $m-1>0$，式 (2.2) 给出
+$\sum_i s_i\ge mt$。每条边对迹贡献两次，故
+
+$$
+\operatorname{tr}L=2\sum_i s_i\ge2mt.
+\tag{2.3}
+$$
+
+对 $2\le j\le n$ 定义
+$q_j=\lambda_j/t-1\ge0$，并置 $Q=\sum_{j=2}^n q_j$。
+共有 $m+1$ 个这样的数，且式 (2.3) 给出
+
+$$
+Q=\frac{\operatorname{tr}L}{t}-(m+1)\ge m-1>0.
+$$
+
+逐项比较分母得到
+
+$$
+\sum_{j=2}^n\frac{q_j}{1+q_j}
+\ge\sum_{j=2}^n\frac{q_j}{1+Q}
+=\frac{Q}{1+Q}\ge\frac{m-1}{m}.
+\tag{2.4}
+$$
+
+因此
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+\frac{tR}{n}
+&=\sum_{j=2}^n\frac1{1+q_j}
+=(m+1)-\sum_{j=2}^n\frac{q_j}{1+q_j}\\
+&\le m+1-\frac{m-1}{m}=m+\frac1m,
+\end{aligned}
+$$
+
+证明了对全部 $2m$ 个独立正电导的上界。
+
+下面证明等号的必要性。式 (2.4) 中后一不等式等号当且仅当
+$Q=m-1$，因为 $Q/(1+Q)$ 严格递增。前一不等式等号当且仅当
+每个正的 $q_j$ 都等于 $Q$。由于 $Q>0$，这等价于恰有一个正的
+$q_j$，其余全为零。因此乘积等号必然要求
+
+$$
+\operatorname{Spec}(L)=\{0,t\text{（重数 }m\text{）},mt\},\qquad
+\sum_i s_i=mt.
+\tag{2.5}
+$$
+
+式 (2.2) 此时也取等号。$L-tI$ 在 $\mathbf1^\perp$ 上半正定，
+且 $\sum_k f_k^{\mathsf T}(L-tI)f_k=0$，所以每项都为零。
+半正定实对称算子的零二次型向量在其核中，故
+$Lf_k=tf_k$，进而 $Lz=tz$ 对每个 $z\in U$ 成立。
+特别地，任取不同的 $i,j$，把这个等式用于 $z=e_{x_i}-e_{x_j}$。
+两个枢纽坐标及第 $i,j$ 个叶坐标分别给出
+
+$$
+a_i-a_j=0,\qquad b_i-b_j=0,\qquad s_i=s_j=t.
+$$
+
+所以存在两个数 $a,b>0$，使所有 $a_i=a$、所有 $b_i=b$，且 $a+b=t$。
+这是从等号推出的限制，不是对竞争者的预设。
+
+对任意这样的叶置换不变电导，令 $s=a+b$。
+$U$ 上的特征值为 $s$，重数 $m-1$。其正交补由
+$e_u,e_v,m^{-1/2}\sum_i e_{x_i}$ 张成，且是不变子空间。
+在这组正交标准基中的矩阵为
+
+$$
+H(a,b)=
+\begin{pmatrix}
+ma&0&-\sqrt m\,a\\
+0&mb&-\sqrt m\,b\\
+-\sqrt m\,a&-\sqrt m\,b&s
+\end{pmatrix}.
+$$
+
+它有零特征值，迹为 $(m+1)s$，三个二阶主子式之和为
+$m^2ab+mab+mab=m(m+2)ab$。因此
+
+$$
+\det(\mu I-H)=
+\mu\bigl(\mu^2-(m+1)s\mu+m(m+2)ab\bigr).
+\tag{2.6}
+$$
+
+在式 (2.5) 的等号情形，$s=t$，式 (2.6) 的两个非零根必须为
+$t,mt$，从而 $m(m+2)ab=mt^2$，即
+
+$$
+a+b=t,\qquad ab=\frac{t^2}{m+2}.
+$$
+
+这个二次方程恰有两组有序解，正是定理中的共同符号公式。
+$m\ge3$ 保证
+$0<\sqrt{(m-2)/(m+2)}<1$，故两组解不同，且每个电导严格为正。
+
+反过来，任取 $t>0$ 和一个共同符号，按定理公式赋予所有边电导。
+则 $s=t$、$ab=t^2/(m+2)$。式 (2.6) 因而有根 $0,t,mt$，
+连同 $U$ 上的 $m-1$ 个特征值 $t$，给出定理所述完整谱。
+由于 $m>1$，最小正特征值确为 $t$。由式 (2.1)，
+
+$$
+R=\frac{m+2}{t}\left(m+\frac1m\right)=\frac{C_m}{t}.
+$$
+
+故这两条正射线上的每一点均取等号，且前面的必要性排除了其他标号边电导。
+∎
+
+## 3. 任意电阻水平上的最大值与非对称性
+
+**定理 3.1（固定电阻的最大值及全部最大点）。** 对每个整数 $m\ge3$
+及每个 $R_0>0$，定义 1.1 的全部正电导在约束 $R(a,b)=R_0$ 下满足
+
+$$
+\max\lambda_2(L(a,b))=\frac{C_m}{R_0}.
+$$
+
+令 $t=C_m/R_0$。恰有两组标号边电导达到这个最大值：对所有 $i$，
+
+$$
+a_i=\frac t2\left(1+\varepsilon\sqrt{\frac{m-2}{m+2}}\right),\qquad
+b_i=\frac t2\left(1-\varepsilon\sqrt{\frac{m-2}{m+2}}\right),
+\qquad \varepsilon\in\{+1,-1\}.
+$$
+
+两组由交换 $u,v$ 互换。若电导函数还定义在非边上，非边取值任意；
+“两组”只指其在 $2m$ 条标号边上的限制。
+
+**证明。** 定理 2.1 对每个可行点给出
+$\lambda_2\le C_m/R_0$。取上式的 $t=C_m/R_0>0$，
+定理 2.1 的充分性给出严格正电导、谱中 $\lambda_2=t$ 及
+$R=C_m/t=R_0$，故上界被达到。若一个可行点达到该上界，
+则其乘积等号成立，由定理 2.1 的必要性必在所列两条射线上，
+且 $R=R_0$ 将射线参数唯一固定为 $C_m/R_0$。
+共同符号仅有两种，并且两者不同，故不存在其余标号边最大点。
+这个存在性由显式构造给出，不要求可行集紧致，也不允许边电导取零。∎
+
+**定理 3.2（无权电阻归一化与 K₂,₃ 的数值）。** 对每个 $m\ge3$，令
+$D_m=m^3+m^2+2m+4$。无权 $K_{2,m}$ 的总电阻及该电阻水平的最大值分别为
+
+$$
+R(K_{2,m};1)=\frac{D_m}{2m},\qquad
+\max_{R=R(K_{2,m};1)}\lambda_2
+=\frac{2(m+2)(m^2+1)}{D_m}>2.
+$$
+
+在这个电阻水平，全部图自同构下不变的可行边电导只有无权赋值，
+其 $\lambda_2=2$，所以任一最大点均不在全部自同构下不变。
+特别地，$m=3$ 时 $R_0=23/3$，最大值为 $50/23$，
+两组最大边电导为所有 $i$ 上的
+
+$$
+(a_i,b_i)=
+\left(\frac{25+5\sqrt5}{23},\frac{25-5\sqrt5}{23}\right)
+\quad\text{或}\quad
+\left(\frac{25-5\sqrt5}{23},\frac{25+5\sqrt5}{23}\right).
+$$
+
+**证明。** 在定理 2.1 的式 (2.6) 中取 $a=b=1$，有 $s=2$，
+二次因子为
+$\mu^2-2(m+1)\mu+m(m+2)=(\mu-m)(\mu-(m+2))$。
+所以无权谱为 $0$、$2$（重数 $m-1$）、$m$、$m+2$。
+式 (2.1) 给出
+
+$$
+\begin{aligned}
+R(K_{2,m};1)
+&=(m+2)\left(\frac{m-1}{2}+\frac1m+\frac1{m+2}\right)\\
+&=\frac{m^3+m^2+2m+4}{2m}.
+\end{aligned}
+$$
+
+代入定理 3.1 即得所述最大值；它超过 $2$ 的差为
+
+$$
+\frac{2(m+2)(m^2+1)}{D_m}-2
+=\frac{2(m-2)(m+1)}{D_m}>0.
+$$
+
+叶置换与枢纽交换都是图自同构，且它们生成的作用在边上传递，
+故在全部自同构下不变的边电导必须恒为同一个数 $c>0$。
+由 $L(c\mathbf1)=cL(\mathbf1)$，所有正特征值乘以 $c$，
+式 (2.1) 给出 $R(c\mathbf1)=R(\mathbf1)/c$。
+约束 $R=R(\mathbf1)>0$ 因而强制 $c=1$，其 $\lambda_2=2$。
+这同时说明两组最大点保留叶置换对称性而破坏枢纽交换对称性。
+
+取 $m=3$ 有 $D_3=46$、$C_3=50/3$，于是
+$R_0=23/3$、$t=50/23$，并且
+$\sqrt{(m-2)/(m+2)}=1/\sqrt5$。
+将它们代入定理 3.1，得到所列两组电导。
+
+既有的 $K_{2,3}$ 可行点
+$a_i=32/23$、$b_i=16/23$ 及其结论
+$R=23/3$、$\lambda_2=48/23$
+直接采用[既有反例的完整结论](../../../Blueprint/D5/S3/Combinatorics/SpectralGraph/FiedlerResistanceInvariantWeightsRefutation.md)。
+其中的标号 $0,1,2,3,4$ 在这里对应 $u,v,x_1,x_2,x_3$，
+边电导和全点对电阻约定完全相同。
+该可行点仍以 $48/23>2$ 排除不变最优点，而
+$48/23<50/23$ 表明它不达到本定理确定的最大值。∎
